roi.src.title: Basis of the estimate.
roi.src.facade.price.text: per m²: the usual price for rope access cleaning of continuous glazing in Moscow, from public price lists
roi.src.facade.output.text: per robot per shift. The manufacturer states 1,200–2,000 m² a day
roi.src.facade.shifts.text: per cleaning season: mid-April to mid-October, excluding rain, wind and weekends
roi.src.facade.kit.text: turnkey X-Human K3 kit, according to the supplier
roi.src.facade.how.steps.compare: We compare it with what you now pay your rope access contractor: glazed area × number of cleanings × price per m².
roi.src.facade.how.steps.share: The robot cleans about 90% of the glazing. Rope access technicians finish corners, canopies and obstructed sections at your price.
roi.src.facade.how.steps.crew: The robot needs a crew of two: an operator and a roof safety attendant. We cost their wages, including income tax and social contributions, for every shift.
roi.src.facade.how.steps.season: The season runs from mid-April to mid-October. A quarter of the days are lost to rain and wind, and work happens on weekdays. One robot handles about 147,000 m² a year. If the volume is larger, we include a second robot in the calculation.
roi.src.facade.how.steps.saving: Savings = what you pay the contractor now − robot cost, brushes and consumables, service at 8% of the price per year, and manual touch-up.
roi.src.facade.how.steps.fit: The robot works on continuous glazing. We check the facade’s suitability and roof mounting space during the assessment.
roi.src.how.steps.payback: Payback is how many months of savings it takes to cover the purchase. The 5-year net gain is the savings over the service life minus the price of the robots.
roi.src.how.steps.lease: Leasing: 20% down payment, 36 months. We show how much you keep each month after the lease payment.
roi.src.floor.wage.text: median cleaner wage in Moscow, from 2026 job postings
roi.src.floor.payroll.text: social contributions: since 2026, most companies pay 30%
roi.src.floor.manual.text: of floor one person cleans by hand per shift
roi.src.floor.robot.text: price of a compact scrubber robot in the Pudu CC1 class
roi.src.floor.how.steps.surface: The robot only handles flat hard floors, about 60% of the area in an office. Restrooms, desks and trash stay with people.
roi.src.floor.how.steps.freed: We calculate how many full-time positions (FTEs) are freed from floor cleaning, with a margin: 30% of the floor work stays with people.
roi.src.floor.how.steps.norm: If you have more cleaners than the norm, each one cleans less, so the same robot frees more FTEs. But never more than half the team.
roi.src.floor.how.steps.saving: Savings = wages with contributions + chemicals and water − robot service, consumables and a share of our platform operator’s time.
